android.desc:
Learn something real in three minutes.

Breni turns PDFs, lecture notes, slides, web pages, YouTube videos or any topic into a personalized AI course made of focused three-minute lessons.

Each lesson teaches one clear idea through visual explanations, active questions and immediate feedback—so even a short break can become meaningful progress.

TURN YOUR MATERIAL INTO A COURSE

• Upload a PDF, Word document or PowerPoint  
• Add a web page or YouTube video  
• Enter any topic you want to understand  
• Choose your level, learning goal and available study time  
• Preview your course units and start learning  

When you create a course from your own material, Breni uses that content to guide what it teaches.

ONE IDEA. THREE MINUTES. REAL LEARNING.

Every Breni lesson focuses on one clear idea and takes about three minutes.

Learn during a break, commute or study session through explanations, visual examples and active practice—not passive scrolling.

Three minutes is short enough to begin now, but structured enough to understand something useful.

LEARN BY DOING

Every lesson combines clear teaching with activities that make you use what you are learning:

• Multiple-choice and true-or-false questions  
• Matching and ordering activities  
• Short written answers  
• Numerical and coding questions  
• Visual diagrams and examples  
• Immediate feedback after every answer  

Instead of generating only another summary or one practice quiz, Breni builds a guided learning path that helps you understand ideas and apply them.

STORIES THAT MAKE IDEAS STICK

Connected stories, real-world situations and recurring characters help ideas build across lessons.

New concepts become part of an unfolding journey instead of feeling like disconnected notes and quiz questions.

LEARNING THAT RESPONDS TO YOU

Breni uses results from previous lessons to keep later learning relevant.

Concepts you miss can return in new questions and situations, helping you revisit difficult ideas without simply repeating the same prompt.

STUDY FOR EXAMS OR LEARN SOMETHING NEW

Use Breni for:

• Exam preparation and revision  
• Lecture notes and class materials  
• Professional reports and training documents  
• Coding and technical subjects  
• Science, history and business  
• Personal interests and new skills  
• Almost any subject you want to explore  

STAY CONSISTENT

• Build daily learning streaks  
• Earn XP and advance

quotes.text:
I'm excited to share SkillsBoost, an app that transforms learning using GPT-4o to create personalized courses from top internet sources.

Key Features:
 Custom Courses with GPT-4: Tailor-made learning paths in various subjects.
 Unlimited Course Creation: Generate courses on any topic with a simple prompt.
 Bite-Sized Lessons: Short, engaging lessons for easy learning.
 AI Personalization: Customized learning at your pace.
 Achievements: Earn badges, maintain streaks, and unlock milestones.
 Source References: Access and browse all references used in courses.

Explore topics from coding to personal finance and take control of your learning journey. Download SkillsBoost today!

I'd love your feedback and suggestions. Thanks for checking it out!
